extras: The plugin makes no network requests and stores all data locally in data.json.
intentEvidence: Turn note-taking into a blocky survival game.
problem: Note-taking can be monotonous, and this plugin aims to increase engagement and motivation through gamification.

relations.evidence: The plugin pairs with the Book and Quill theme, which turns Obsidian into a leather-bound book on a dirt background.

summary: Transforms note-taking into a blocky survival game by awarding XP for writing, tracking advancements, and adding page-turning mechanics.
